bear_assumptions: USD 4.5 billion forward revenue at about 6x enterprise value/revenue, approximately USD 0.5 billion net debt and 350 million diluted shares; deployments slip, utilization or pricing weakens, capex and customer-advance dependence persist, and modeled dilution is realized.
base_assumptions: USD 6.5 billion forward revenue at about 9x enterprise value/revenue, approximately USD 0.5 billion net debt and 350 million diluted shares; contracts convert on schedule, adjusted EBITDA stays positive, free cash flow remains negative, and concentration does not materially improve.
bull_assumptions: USD 10 billion forward revenue at about 11.5x enterprise value/revenue, approximately USD 0.5 billion net debt and 350 million diluted shares; capacity delivers on time, utilization and margins remain strong, asset-backed funding scales efficiently, and customer breadth improves.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if fresh primary evidence and a new scenario set clear expected-return, base-upside, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, margin-of-safety, confidence and accepted-relationship gates; downgrade evidence quality if deployments slip, utilization or pricing weakens, customer advances reverse, capex or leverage outruns economics, dilution rises, or concentration worsens.
